mapper.select: SELECT g.GenreId, g.Name, g.Slug, g.Description, COUNT(s.StoryId) AS StoryCount FROM dbo.Genre g LEFT JOIN dbo.StoryGenre sg ON sg.GenreId = g.GenreId LEFT JOIN dbo.vw_PublicStory s ON s.StoryId = sg.StoryId GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name, g.Slug, g.Description, g.SortOrder ORDER BY g.SortOrder, g.GenreId

SELECT TOP (#{limit}) TagId, Name, Slug, UsageCount FROM dbo.Tag
(Name LIKE #{namePrefix} ESCAPE '\' OR Slug LIKE #{slugPrefix} ESCAPE '\')
ORDER BY UsageCount DESC, Name
